statement: Hardness of coloring three-colorable graphs. It is NP-hard to color a three-colorable graph using any fixed number c ≥ 3 of colors. More strongly, for every fixed $`0\lt \delta\lt 1/3`$, a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from 3SAT produces simple unweighted graphs that are three-colorable in the satisfiable case and have no independent set of size $`\delta n`$ otherwise, where n is the number of vertices.
